One optimal approach is: Choose nums[0..3] = [4, 2, 5, 1]. The maximum is 5 and the minimum is 1, giving a value of 5 - 1 = 4. Choose nums[0..3] = [4, 2, 5, 1]. The maximum is 5 and the minimum is 1, so the value is also 4. Choose nums[2..3] = [5, 1]. The maximum is 5 and the minimum is 1, so the value is again 4. Adding these gives 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.
